answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust graph, and EigenTrust matrix factorization derives centrality scores that undergo exponential temporal decay. A freshly spawned sybil, even when forming a jetty of colluding accounts at an inlet, begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality; only sustained, mutually validated honest service can increase its reputation, so any fable of instant influence cannot cross consensus thresholds.
